three.module.js + three.core.js
================================

Source:  https://unpkg.com/three@0.186.0/build/three.module.js
         https://unpkg.com/three@0.186.0/build/three.core.js
Version: 0.186.0
License: MIT (https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/dev/LICENSE)

Two files because this three.js release splits its ES module build:
three.module.js imports from ./three.core.js — both must be vendored
together, same directory, same version.

Vendored as plain ES modules (not a CDN import) so Windward has no runtime
dependency on unpkg/jsdelivr — Stage W0, Batch 1. Owner: felix (games/windward/
only; this is not shared/vendor/ — see AGENTS.md's Windward concept note on
why it isn't promoted to a shared vendor path yet). Import it with a relative
path from src/, e.g. `import * as THREE from '../vendor/three/three.module.js'`.

To update: bump the version above, re-fetch both files from
`https://unpkg.com/three@<version>/build/<file>`, and smoke-test Windward's
solo dev entry (games/windward/index.html) still renders before committing
the bump.
